R1_blocking.quote: from the newest inbox actions run record read only its Summary's "worked to"; STEP 1: "created after the newest record's \"worked to\" (none yet: created since 2026-10-29)"
R1_blocking.scenario: RUN RECORD creates this run's Started record before STEP 1, so the newest record is its own, with no worked to: every run reads 'none yet' and re-takes everything since 29 Oct. Same after a crash (Started left) or a No-op/Failed run (no Activity finished, so no worked to).
R1_blocking.fix: "from the newest inbox actions run record other than this run's that has a worked to"; and "worked to: the later of the previous worked to and ...; a run that finished none carries the previous one".

R2_blocking.quote: plus any whose page body has the line "actions: due", oldest first ... worked to <the newest created time of the mail Activities you finished, never past one you didn't>
R2_blocking.scenario: Notion query filters properties, not page body, so due rows whose created time is behind the cursor are never found. If found, they sort first: 25 old due rows set worked to back to 30 Oct (or 'never past one you didn't' pins it there), and the next run re-works everything since.
R2_blocking.fix: Flag in a property capture sets (e.g. Captured = today, as README says, or a new 'Actions' select Due/Done). worked to is computed only from cursor-selected rows, never moves backward; due rows are extra, outside the cursor.

R3_blocking.quote: created after the newest record's "worked to"
R3_blocking.scenario: Notion created time is minute-granular. Actions finishes A (created :26) while capture (overrun) or Zoya creates B in the same minute after the query; worked to = :26, strict 'after' drops B forever.
R3_blocking.fix: "created at or after worked to minus 2 minutes; skip any whose body has 'actions: done'" (needs R7).

R4_blocking.quote: STEP 2b: "For each Email out among the mail Activities you work that Akshay sent"; STEP 5: "Our side replied and the ball is in their court: Guest or PR"
R4_blocking.scenario: Capture's own loop-in ('Akshay to <name>: Zoya loop-in', Kind Email out, msgid:) is now an actions input. In the single prompt STEP 6 logged it after 2b ran. Repeat pitch: capture sets 'Akshay: <guest> pitched again ... Write it in Your call'; actions 2b(b)/STEP 5 reads the loop-in as his answer, takes him off and sets Waiting on Guest or PR.
R4_blocking.fix: STEP 1: "Loop-in Activities (Summary ending 'Zoya loop-in') get only a ledger line 'n/a (loop-in)'."

R5_blocking.quote: "worked to" never passes a mail you didn't finish.
R5_blocking.scenario: One Activity whose THREAD can't be read fails every run: worked to frozen, the 24 after it re-worked hourly (STEP 3, 5, 6e re-queue Zoya steps), new mail beyond 25 never reached.
R5_blocking.fix: "An Activity unfinished in 3 runs gets 'actions: stuck <why>' in its body and on the report's For Akshay line, and no longer holds worked to."

R6_should_fix.quote: The mail Activities (Kind Email in or Email out, Source ID msgid:)
R6_should_fix.scenario: Zoya logs her inbox mail the same way (zoya-one: msgid:, Kind Email in, Source Gmail). Actions works it at :25 before Zoya's :38 run: 6e bucket B can cancel a calendar event, C puts Akshay on the list for mail Zoya owns, STEP 3 moves Status from her sends.
R6_should_fix.fix: "only Activities the capture routine logged (body line 'capture: <run id>', which capture adds)".

R7_should_fix.quote: Finishing one replaces "actions: due" with "actions: done <date>"
R7_should_fix.scenario: Only re-keyed rows get a done mark; with CURSOR, NOT PRECEDENT forbidding the old ledger, any cursor reset (R1, R2, first run over mail the old inbox already acted on) re-works with no key.
R7_should_fix.fix: "Every Activity you finish gets the body line 'actions: done <run id>'; one that has it is skipped."

R8_blocking.quote: Read the whole page every run, before STEP 0; it wins where it differs. Page not readable in full: skip STEP 0 and every mail step, end Failed.
R8_blocking.scenario: A truncated fetch, or a page where someone shortened section 6, reads fine and looks complete; nothing defines 'in full'. Neither section has an end marker or a version.
R8_blocking.fix: Add a last line to section 7: 'END OF SECTIONS 6-7 (yourcall v1, 1 Nov)'. Prompt: "In full means both headings '## 6. Your call' and '## 7. WhatsApp to Akshay' and that end line are present; any missing: Failed."

R9_should_fix.quote: Log the Activity with Summary starting "Edit notes: <guest>"
R9_should_fix.scenario: Capture already logged it (D7); actions logs a second Activity for the same mail.
R9_should_fix.fix: "The capture routine logged it; link the Episode if missing, then file and hand off."

R10_should_fix.quote: (none: no lock or overlap rule in capture or actions)
R10_should_fix.scenario: Capture over :25, or actions over :38, does read-modify-write on Next action and Waiting on with Zoya on the same rows ('Read the current Waiting on first and write back the full list'); a lost update brings back a step Zoya cleared. Two actions runs (over 60 min) take the same cursor, and both can send WhatsApp to Akshay before Your call is cleared.
R10_should_fix.fix: Both: "newest own record Started, under 55 min old and not this run: record Skipped and stop." Capture stops taking mail at :20, actions at :35 (date), ending Partial; STEP 0 is exempt.

R11_should_fix.quote: Section 6: "a decision mail goes as in STEP 6c"; STEP 6c: "At most 15 per run."
R11_should_fix.scenario: 16+ ok's in Your call: the 6c cap shortens STEP 0, against 'never capped'.
R11_should_fix.fix: "At most 15 per run, except decisions from STEP 0."

R12_should_fix.quote: SELF-CHECK ... query Activities captured today, created after the start, Kind Email in or Email out. Any whose Source ID doesn't start "msgid:" goes to Trash
R12_should_fix.scenario: It isn't scoped to this run. A Zoya row keyed by its provider-id fallback, or a chat session's row, created during capture's run gets trashed, and the run ends Failed.
R12_should_fix.fix: "Activities this run created (ids in your ledger)".

R13_should_fix.quote: actions STEP 8: "Mail Activities worked (window by Captured time)"; actions ZOYA LIVE "capture-only, CTO 21 Oct"; capture ZOYA LIVE "and WHATSAPP TO AKSHAY"; README "Captured set to today" vs capture STEP 0 body line
R13_should_fix.scenario: Leftover D1/D9 text that contradicts the cursor and send scope.
R13_should_fix.fix: "window by created time (worked to)"; drop 'capture-only'; drop 'and WHATSAPP TO AKSHAY'; align README.

R14_should_fix.quote: Section 7: send, "Then clear Your call ... Log an Activity"
R14_should_fix.scenario: A failure after the send and before the clear resends next hour. 'Read the Claude note, Activities' finds nothing, because both are written after the send.
R14_should_fix.fix: "Before sending, write the Claude note line 'WhatsApp to Akshay sending <topic>'; one there: don't resend."
